name: Unrestricted LP333 pq2 six-coordinate escape anneal
hypothesis: Periodic simultaneous three-swap proposals may cross exact-PAF barriers that reject every intermediate one-swap state and thereby reach a directly verifiable Legendre pair inside the prescribed pq2-compression slice.
evidence_unit: one deterministic 3600-second mixed-neighborhood run from seed 20260727 with the same exact margins, squared integer PAF objective, temperature endpoints, and 2000000-proposal restart length as the baseline, replacing every eighth proposal by three sequential same-residue swaps accepted or rejected atomically
claim_boundary: The six-coordinate mechanism is an inferred transfer from a different 37-compression landscape, where a public technical report found local minima under changes of up to four entries. No quantitative rate transfers. Only a serialized zero objective that independently verifies all 332 nonzero PAF equations is a candidate; any lower score is workload evidence.

baseline.evidence: The frozen single-swap pq2 run uses source SHA-256 7aa7e3652bb92920972a7d2828cb65b152c45e2c8090b76f3203150ab18c8032, seed 20260727, 2000000 proposals per restart, and an initial exact squared residual of 130304.
baseline.measurement: The active baseline first reached best objective 5568, L1 residual 720, and maximum absolute residual 20; it had not reached zero after more than 1.8 billion proposals.

intervention.one_change: Keep seven of every eight proposals as one exact same-residue opposite-sign swap, but make every eighth proposal an atomic composition of three such swaps, affecting at most six coordinates across the two rows.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a nonzero or unaudited state

controls.name: cross-regime-paper-boundary
controls.purpose: Prevent the source report's 37-compression behavior from being cited as evidence for this full-length landscape.
controls.expected: The report supplies only the qualitative hypothesis that coordinated changes beyond four entries can escape isolated local minima; its energy values, rates, and success projections are not transferred.

controls.name: matched-initial-state
controls.purpose: Bind the new mechanism to the baseline start.
controls.expected: Seed 20260727 reconstructs the same initial objective 130304, L1 residual 3864, maximum residual 64, and six exact pq2 margins.

controls.name: mixed-delta-self-test
controls.purpose: Detect incorrect atomic composition of incremental PAF updates.
controls.expected: Across 2000 deterministic mixed proposals, including every eighth as three swaps, every stored PAF and objective equals a fresh O(333^2) recomputation and all six margins remain exact.

controls.name: mechanism-telemetry
controls.purpose: Prove the intervention fired at its frozen cadence.
controls.expected: The companion mechanism result records triple_proposal_period 8, triple_proposal_coordinates 6, self-test PASS, and triple_swap_proposals equal floor(total_proposals/8).

controls.name: independent-full-result-audit
controls.purpose: Recompute the mathematical endpoint outside the C implementation.
controls.expected: The existing independent Python bit-rotation auditor recomputes both 333-entry PAF vectors, all six margins, row sums, objective, L1 and maximum residual, and exact candidate status.

controls.name: source-and-binary-pin
controls.expected: Source SHA-256 029ef4f8b64726001c253f1b404da9cf5fc262fba48f6038cd813e1c7c3d3a1f and compiled binary SHA-256 c7e913737463e3e13e58486d6bf53c92192fa8761e41628762637a8e527b825f.

primary_metric.name: independently verified exact squared PAF residual

terminal_outcomes.promote: The best squared residual is exactly zero and the independent full result audit verifies both row sums, the prescribed compression, and all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen 3600-second schedule completes with valid mechanism telemetry and an independently audited nonzero best residual.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule before it writes and audits its best state.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any matched-start, mixed-delta, cadence, source pin, binary pin, stored-score, full PAF, candidate-status, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Run only the pinned source and binary at seed 20260727.
Use 2000000 proposals per restart, the baseline 512-to-0.25 exponential cooling schedule, and exactly one triple-swap proposal every eight proposals.
Stop immediately at exact zero objective.
Otherwise stop at 3600 wall seconds without another seed, frequency, temperature, restart length, or cap.
Run the independent full bit-rotation audit before interpreting the endpoint.
Do not promote a lower nonzero heuristic score.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, perform a second direct Legendre-pair audit, construct H668, verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, then package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the endpoint and retire this exact cadence; use any improved score only to characterize the neighborhood, not to justify parameter tuning in this campaign.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interrupted state and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if the interruption is reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest source, cadence, delta, serialization, or verifier defect before any target rerun.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned code, and public primary or technical literature are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
